entry.name: fftinfo~
entry.digest: Report information about a patcher loaded by pfft~
entry.description: fftinfo~ gets info about the fft frames in a patcher loaded by a pfft~. It reports the information when sent a bang or whenever DSP is turned on via a dac~ ( fftinfo~ only functions within a pfft~).

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Output the window size, frame size, and hop size
messages.description: Causes the FFT window size, the FFT frame size (i.e., the signal vector size inside the patcher loaded by), and the FFT hop size to be sent out the object's outputs.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Report the window size, frame size, and hop size of a connected signal network
messages.description: Reports the FFT window size, the FFT frame size, and the FFT hop size of the signal network to which it is connected.
